newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Turkish forces begin north Cyprus war games.
newsitem.headline: Turkish forces begin north Cyprus war games.

text.p: Turkish and Turkish Cypriot forces began four days of joint military manoeuvres on and around northern Cyprus on Monday, Turkish Cypriot defence officials said.

Around 30,000 troops as well as tanks, ships and planes will take part in the exercises in the self-proclaimed Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus and the waters of the eastern Mediterranean. Live ammunition will be used, they said.

The war games are held annually but Turkish Cypriot officials said they would be bigger this year in response to joint Greek and Cypriot manoeuvres on the Greek-Cypriot, government-controlled part of the island in October.
Turkey invaded Cyprus in 1974 after a Greek-inspired coup attempt in Nicosia. The Turkish Cypriot state set up in 1983 is recognised only by Ankara.
